title: All The Same
text: All The Same. If you have used the old school sprouter lids you'll remember that they are different sizes based on the seeds you want to sprout. These have all the same kind of wire mesh in them which I suppose is OK if you are doing the same thing all the time.  The klugey little stands are kind of overkill.
